title: SLO→OKR Calendar and Automated Remediation Window Orchestrator
creator: Clara Nguyen
description: Define and implement an initiative-level orchestration layer that maps SLI targets and live error-budget burn to OKR checkpoints on the product roadmap, schedules calendarized remediation windows when burn exceeds thresholds, and creates automated gating/rollback recommendations for dependent releases.
acceptance_criteria: A dashboard that shows initiative→OKR mapping with current SLI vs target and projected error-budget runway
Automated creation of 'Remediation Window' calendar events in team calendars when error-budget crosses the warning threshold
Playbook links and suggested rollback/fallback actions appear in the initiative card when burn hits critical threshold
Configurable cadence and ownership for remediation windows (daily 1hr, weekly 4hr, etc.) per initiative
Integration tests that simulate SLI degradation and validate calendar creation + initiative gating logic
progress_updates: 2025-02-12: Scoped integration points with Console telemetry and Initiative Hub. Confirmed required telemetry fields with infra (p99 latency, error-rate, throughput).
2025-02-20: Prototype data model for initiative→sli mapping in Confluence (link below). Walked through with eng leads; they requested field for 'rollback impact surface'.
2025-02-28: Eng spike completed for calendar API (Google Calendar + Outlook). Found rate limits—added backoff logic. PR #842 in progress.
2025-03-03: PM/design sync: remediation window UX should show suggested timeframe + required attendees. Design mockups uploaded to Figma.
2025-03-05: Began wiring alerts from SLO service to orchestration lambda; first end-to-end smoke test scheduled 2025-03-10.
decisions: Orchestration will be part of the 'Reliability Initiative Framework' service rather than Console frontend to allow reuse across Dedicated/Private deployments.
Use 3-tier thresholds (warning, action, critical) derived from existing error-budget policy; thresholds configurable per initiative.
Calendar integration will support read/write for Google and Exchange in phase 1; invite templates will be editable by initiative owners.
risks: Calendar API rate limits may cause missed remediation invites under high churn—mitigated with batching and exponential backoff.
Automated gating recommendations could be ignored by teams; require SRE approval workflow to enforce critical gates.
Mapping SLI metrics to initiative-level impact is fuzzy for cross-cutting infra issues—requires guardrails and manual override.
open_questions: Should remediation windows auto-cancel if error budget recovers before the scheduled time?
What's the exact escalation path and who is the approver for enforced rollback recommendations?
How do we represent multi-initiative incidents where a single SLI breach affects several OKRs?
dependencies: ENG-3110: SLO event streaming schema finalized
